title: 第15章  面刺本大人之过者处极刑
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
一众血奴闻言，眼中的恐惧顿时消退大半。

    “对，陈家主说得在理！”

    “别怕，他以寡敌众，肯定是想用这种手段吓退我们！”

    “原来如此，我猜他的灵力快要见底了。”

    “上！别让他有喘息的机会！”

    庭院之中，一只血奴大吼一声，眼神死死盯着前方的陆渊。

    也不知道是不是错觉，他竟看到陆渊的嘴角勾起了一抹细微的弧度。

    那个人在笑？

    怎么可能？

    然而还没等他细想，周围的血奴一拥而上，向着陆渊扑杀而去。

    见到这一幕，吴守信已是心急如焚。

    虽说陆渊出手看似轻描淡写，但每一道晶刺都是用海量灵力压缩而成。

    单单只是这个过程，就是一股极大的消耗。

    以他自己的灵力总量来算，刚才那两道晶刺至少要消耗三成灵力。

    而陆渊只是刚入初境，灵力总量肯定不如他，想来这个消耗还要更高！

    想到这里，吴守信强撑着站直身子，打算上前支援。

    却没想到陆渊对他摇了摇头，意思很明显，不需要他插手。

    吴守信动作一顿，看着那冷峻面孔，不知对方是哪里来的底气。

    既然如此，他也只能听命行事。

    长刀拄地，眉宇间却难掩担忧之色。

    庭院中，当先的几只血奴已经杀到陆渊面前。

    最近的那只探爪袭来，凛冽劲风将他衣袍刮得猎猎作响。

    那只血奴瞳孔中爆发嗜血之色，本想乘胜追击，心底却突然涌起前所未有的恐惧。

    连带着那些扑杀而来的血奴也猛地一滞，猩红的眸子中满是惊悚。

    只见陆渊眼眸冷冽，如渊似海的灵力气息向周边倾轧而去，一道道晶刺在身边凝结。

    灵力化晶？

    吴守信不禁眼皮一跳，目光中充斥着难以理解的复杂。

    他的灵力难道用不完吗？

    如此多的晶刺，他究竟是怎么做到的？

    即便是自己这种老牌初境，也无法将灵力这么用啊！

    回应他的，是陆渊的一声轻喝。

    “去！”

    一瞬间，数十道晶刺猛地射出，如暴雨般倾盆而去。

    刺耳的破空声撕裂夜幕，密集的光痕贯穿庭院，快得只剩下残影。

    吴守信只觉得眼前一花，紧接着，就听到连绵不绝的穿刺闷响。

    那些血奴的身躯如同被长矛贯穿，手臂粗细的血洞不断在身上炸开。
content_en:
When the blood slaves heard this, most of the fear in their eyes disappeared.

    "Yes, Master Chen is right!"

    "Don't be afraid, he is outnumbered and must be trying to scare us away with this method!"

    "I see. I guess his spiritual power is about to reach its bottom."

    "Go! Don't let him have a chance to breathe!"

    In the courtyard, a blood slave roared and stared at Lu Yuan in front of him.

    He didn't know if it was an illusion, but he actually saw a slight curve in the corner of Lu Yuan's mouth.

    Is that person smiling?

    How is that possible?

    However, before he could think about it, the blood slaves around him swarmed up and rushed toward Lu Yuan.

    Seeing this scene, Wu Shouxin was extremely anxious.

    Although Lu Yuan's attack seemed to be an understatement, each crystal thorn was compressed with massive spiritual power.

    This process alone is a huge consumption.

    Calculated based on his own total spiritual power, the two crystal thorns just now consumed at least 30% of his spiritual power.

    And Lu Yuan has just entered the first level, and his total spiritual power is definitely not as good as him. I think the consumption will be even higher!

    Thinking of this, Wu Shouxin stood up straight and planned to step forward to support.

    But he didn't expect Lu Yuan to shake his head at him. The meaning was obvious and there was no need for him to intervene.

    Wu Shouxin made a move and looked at the stern face, wondering where the other party's confidence came from.

    In this case, he could only obey orders.

    He leaned his sword on the ground, but he couldn't hide the worry between his brows.

    In the courtyard, the first few blood slaves had already killed themselves in front of Lu Yuan.

    The nearest probing claw struck, and the strong wind blew his robes into pieces.

    The blood slave's eyes burst out with bloodlust. He wanted to pursue the victory, but an unprecedented fear suddenly surged in his heart.

    Even the blood slaves who came to kill him suddenly froze, their scarlet eyes full of horror.

    I saw Lu Yuan's eyes were cold, and the aura of spiritual energy like a deep and sea was rushing towards the surroundings, and crystal thorns condensed around him.

    Spiritual power crystallized?

    Wu Shouxin couldn't help but his eyelids twitched, his eyes filled with incomprehensible complexity.

    Can’t he use up all his spiritual power?

    How on earth did he achieve so many crystal thorns?

    Even a veteran like me, who is in the first level, cannot use spiritual power like this!

    What responded to him was a soft drink from Lu Yuan.

    "Go!"

    In an instant, dozens of crystal thorns shot out fiercely, pouring down like a torrential rain.

    The piercing sound of the sky tore through the night, and dense traces of light penetrated the courtyard so fast that only afterimages were left.

    Wu Shouxin's eyes only felt blurred, and then he heard the continuous muffled sound of puncture.

    The bodies of those blood slaves seemed to have been penetrated by spears, and blood holes as thick as their arms continued to explode in their bodies.
title_en: Chapter 15 Anyone who stabs me in the face shall be punished with death
